note: The English bio and FAQ quote no scripture and carry no Book C:V citations; the three block quotations are Studd's own words (and the couplet he loved), translated as prose.

Names follow the shipped lg bios: Bungereza, Buyindi, China, Kongo ey’Ababirigi, Moody, Sankey, Müller, Hudson Taylor, Eggye ery’Obulokozi; institutions and titles stay in English (China Inland Mission, Cambridge Seven / Abasanvu ab’e Cambridge, Heart of Africa Mission, WEC, The Chocolate Soldier). Quotation marks mirror the source (curly in the bio, straight in the FAQ).

The English contradicts itself in three places, each translated as written: father's conversion about 1875 (bio) vs 1877 (FAQ 2); George's illness 1883 (bio) vs 1884 (FAQ 3); no surgery near Ibambi (bio) vs refusing 'the care his body needed' (FAQ 10).
